integrity: Finite exact-arithmetic checks supplement, but do not establish, the general geometric argument. Independent validation is not performed.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic two and other exponents n are excluded; uniqueness at q=9,11 is open here; no complete Brill–Noether study; novelty relative to all historical superelliptic results not formally certified.
title: Gonality and tetragonal-pencil rigidity of the maximal Kummer curves \(y^{q+1}=x^2(x^2+1)\)
